Settings now shows which version you are running.

## What changes

The version number lived only in the sidebar, next to the logo, where it reads as decoration. It is now a line of its own in Settings, under Application, which is where you look when you want to know what you are running or quote it in a bug report.

It comes from the same source as the application itself, so it cannot drift: a number hardcoded in the screen would stay true on screen and false in the world.

## Also in this version

Release notes are published again. Since 2.0.1, the job that creates the GitHub release had no checkout step, so the notes file it was told to read did not exist on the build machine. The release went out with an empty body and no error. The notes for 2.0.1 and 2.1.0 have been restored on their existing releases, and a check now refuses any workflow that reads a repository file without first fetching the repository.

The README no longer offers an Intel `.dmg`. That file has never been produced: macOS builds are Apple Silicon only. Intel Macs are pointed at the from-source installation instead of a download that does not exist.
